scripts.dev: bun run --filter @brio/api dev & bun run --filter @brio/app dev
scripts.ext:install: for dir in extensions/hooks/* extensions/endpoints/* extensions/interfaces/* extensions/modules/*; do [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && (cd "$dir" && bun install); done
scripts.ext:build: for dir in extensions/hooks/* extensions/endpoints/* extensions/interfaces/* extensions/modules/*; do [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && (echo "Building $dir..." && cd "$dir" && bun run build && cd - > /dev/null); done
scripts.ext:dev: for dir in extensions/hooks/* extensions/endpoints/* extensions/interfaces/* extensions/modules/*; do [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && (cd "$dir" && bun run dev &); done
